target_customer: Fashion and footwear brands, and consumers shopping live and mobile; early focus on sneaker power resellers
problem: Brands depend on Shopify without built-in demand; resellers juggle spreadsheets and several platforms.
business_model: Marketplace take rate and fulfillment fees (not sourced)
product_category: Direct to consumer marketplace with live commerce and influencer network

founders.name: Ricky Nariani
founders.background_notes: Led M&A and partnerships on IBM's corporate development team (YC page).

founders.name: Quyen Hua
founders.background_notes: About 10 years as a graphic designer, then UI/UX.

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace, live video and order flows are standard mobile commerce engineering for a 4 person team.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplace channels were copyable and large platforms already operated live and resale commerce.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented. Whatnot later raised large rounds in live commerce, per 2025 and 2026 coverage.

market_need_then: Employbl describes sneaker resellers using spreadsheets and several platforms; the YC pitch says brands face a cold start problem outside Shopify.

branding.name_origin: One profile says the name was inspired by the desire to want more; secondary source.
branding.domain_note: Uses getwantd.com with a 'get' prefix and a dropped vowel in the spelling.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand found and the stylized spelling collides with Wanted and similar names.

pivots.to: D2C marketplace and influencer network for fashion and footwear brands
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from differing descriptions across Crunchbase and YC.

outcome_analysis: WANTD pitched a mobile first marketplace for fashion and footwear brands with live commerce and influencer channels, and had a 4 person team. No funding, traction or exit was verified, and sources conflict on whether it still operates. Strong incumbents in resale and live commerce make the wedge hard, but no failure cause is public.
notes: Status conflict: YC directory says Active, PitchBook lists Out of Business; unverified. The getwantd.com fetch returned 503. VCBacked lists a March 2022 seed with YC, Slow Ventures, Goodwater, Pioneer Fund and DG Daiwa Ventures and no amount; Employbl lists about 1.72M and a 2019 founding year; single aggregators, so no round is recorded. Crunchbase lists Donald Engel and Employbl lists Bill Newhart as co-founders; not on the YC page, so not recorded. Competitor sources are undated.
